snippet.title: LOVE ETERNAL - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
On February 19th 2026, wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. 

Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more. LOVE ETERNAL will be available on Steam (Windows), Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox consoles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010610/LOVE_ETERNAL/
